title: The Night the Mushrooms Took Seats
description: On the last warm evening of autumn, mushrooms fill the seats of an old woodland theater. The smallest performer opens its cap, and a shower of gold takes the stage.
alt: Red and ochre mushrooms fill rows of velvet seats in a mossy woodland theater while a pale mushroom sheds golden spores onstage.
pairing: End-of-autumn holiday × a woodland theater full of mushrooms
